steps.en: Notices past the driver's first letter become candidates for the electronic reminder
steps.id: Notice yang lewat surat pertama driver jadi kandidat reminder elektronik
steps.why_en: The system only sees the stage, which moves on even when the letter never reached the vendor.
steps.why_id: Sistem hanya melihat tahap, yang tetap maju walau surat tidak sampai ke vendor.

steps.en: The driver's latest mobile number is checked with the government data source
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru driver dicek ke sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The check is switched off in settings, so the number typed on the furnish form is used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan dimatikan di pengaturan, jadi nomor dari form furnish yang dipakai.

steps.en: The electronic reminder is prepared only when the driver has a valid mobile number
steps.id: Reminder elektronik disiapkan hanya bila driver punya nomor mobile valid

steps.en: The check runs by itself every day before the reminder goes out
steps.id: Pengecekan berjalan otomatis tiap hari sebelum reminder dikirim
steps.why_en: The daily run is switched off in settings; it only runs when someone starts it.
steps.why_id: Jadwal harian dimatikan di pengaturan; hanya jalan bila dipicu manual.
